segments.name: Flat-Roll
products: Processing or Storage of Customer Owned Coil
segments.description: Converts carbon steel, stainless steel and aluminum flat-roll products into sheet, plate or slit coil for customers.
segments.evidence: The Company's flat-roll operations consist primarily of converting carbon steel, stainless steel and aluminum flat-roll products into sheet, plate or slit coil.

segments.name: Tubular
segments.description: Purchases, processes, manufactures and markets tubular products, primarily steel pipe, within the United States.
segments.evidence: Through its tubular operations, the Company purchases, processes, manufactures and markets tubular products.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company primarily for sales of metal products out of inventory, with a portion of revenue from processing or storing customer-owned material, recognized when title transfers.
revenueModel.evidence: Most of the Company's revenue is generated by sales of material out of the Company's inventory but a portion of the Company's revenue is derived from processing or storage of customer owned material.
